name: auth
title: Authentication
description: Email and password accounts with Better Auth, stored in Cloudflare D1 through Drizzle. Adds /login, a protected /account example and session helpers.
notes: The "Get started" button on the home page now links to /login.
Local: ready. Run yarn dev, then open /login.
Production: run `yarn auth:setup` once. It creates the D1 database, writes its id to wrangler.jsonc, applies the migrations, and prints the BETTER_AUTH_SECRET to add as a secret on the Worker.
Protect a page by copying the beforeLoad guard from src/routes/account.tsx.
